content.title: Selena Gomez Sparks Pregnancy Buzz At Launch Of Her Beauty Brand Within 6 Months Of Her Wedding
content.text: Global icon, Selena Gomez, who is well-recognised for her blockbuster songs like Who Says, Single Soon, Feel Me, Lose You To Love Me and more is currently dominating the headlines for the foundation launch of her brand. The event happened on April 2, 2026; however, what grabbed attention was Selena's oversized outfit, which made fans believe that the singer might be expecting her first child with her husband, Benny Blanco. Is Selena Gomez pregnant within 6 months of her marriage? Recently, the global singer, Selena Gomez turned heads in a metallic bubblegum-pink minidress, reportedly designed by Miuccia Prada and Raf Simons. She was present to celebrate the launch of her brand, Rare Beauty's 'True to Myself' natural matte foundation. However, moments after the photos went viral on social media, multiple users speculated that the singer might be expecting her first child as she opted for a loose and oversized outfit. Sharing Selena Gomez’s photos on social media, one user commented, "I think Selena Gomez is pregnant." Another user shared, "When you think it’s a joke on April fools but it’s actually real. She’s really pregnant guys." A third fan wrote, "I read yesterday that she’s pregnant again. Not sure how accurate that is but I did read it somewhere." It is worth mentioning that neither Selena nor her husband, Benny has addressed the pregnancy buzz. When Selena Gomez revealed that she couldn’t carry her own child While there have been multiple speculations about Selena Gomez being pregnant, do you know that the singer can’t carry her own child due to multiple health issues? Well, for the unversed, Selena had a candid conversation with Vanity Fair, during which she opened up about the same. When asked about if she has spoken about not being able to carry her child, the singer-turned-actress was quoted as saying: "I haven’t ever said this, but I unfortunately can’t carry my own children. I have a lot of medical issues that would put my life and the baby’s in jeopardy. That was something I had to grieve for a while." Later, the Lose You To Love Me singer also opened up about adopting a child and having one with surrogacy. Selena Gomez had once shared that after her diagnosis with lupus, it is not safe for her to have a child because of the medications. According to a report by BBC, Selena’s mother is also adopted. Sharing her thoughts on adoption and surrogacy, the Only Murders In The Building star shared: Continue reading below "It’s not necessarily the way I envisioned it. I thought it would happen the way it happens for everyone. I’m in a much better place with that. I find it a blessing that there are wonderful people willing to do surrogacy or adoption, which are both huge possibilities for me. It made me really thankful for the other outlets for people who are dying to be moms. I’m one of those people. I’m excited for what that journey will look like, but it’ll look a little different. At the end of the day, I don’t care. It’ll be mine. It’ll be my baby." Selena Gomez is married to Benny Blanco Selena Gomez and Benny Blanco are one of the most talked-about couples. Reportedly, the two met while working on a song. Gradually, their professional relationship blossomed into personal romance. In late 2023, the duo made their relationship public. Later, the two were often seen cheering the loudest for each other. In December 2024, the singer confirmed her engagement with Benny Blanco. Later, in September 2025, the duo tied the knot in an intimate ceremony in California. What are your thoughts on Selena Gomez’s pregnancy rumours? Let us know.
